model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The chart titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the absolute mean values of three different hidden state metrics across layers in a neural network model. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” represents discrete integer layer indices ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The vertical axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick marks at intervals of 1 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The units on the vertical axis are not explicitly labeled but are implied to be absolute mean values.

Three distinct lines are plotted:

- The blue dashed line represents “hidden state mean before gate,” with an average value of 0.71. It begins near 0 at layer 0, exhibits minor fluctuations between approximately 0.1 and 0.4 through layer 20, and then rises sharply after layer 20, reaching approximately 4.0 at the final data point near layer 22.
- The orange dotted line represents “hidden state mean after gate,” with an average value of 0.05. It remains very close to zero across all layers, fluctuating slightly between approximately 0.02 and 0.06, and ends near 0.04 at layer 22.
- The green solid line represents “hidden state mean of baseline,” with an average value of 0.04. It remains consistently near zero across all layers, fluctuating slightly between approximately 0.02 and 0.04, and ends near 0.04 at layer 22.

The chart visually demonstrates that the “hidden state mean before gate” metric increases substantially after layer 20, while the other two metrics remain relatively stable and close to zero throughout.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图名为“Hidden State Mean”，展示的是在不同层（Layer）上，隐藏状态均值的绝对值（Abs Mean）随层索引的变化情况。横轴为“Layer”，数值范围从0到约25，刻度为线性，单位为层，刻度间隔为5。纵轴为“Abs Mean”，数值范围从0到约4.5，刻度为线性，单位为绝对值均值，刻度间隔为1。图中包含三条线：一条为蓝色虚线，标记为“hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”，在x=0处值约为0.1，在x=20处值约为1.2，在x=25处值约为4.3；一条为橙色点划线，标记为“hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”，在x=0处值约为0.01，在x=25处值约为0.03，整体数值极低且变化平缓；一条为绿色实线，标记为“hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”，在x=0处值约为0.01，在x=25处值约为0.03，整体数值极低且变化平缓。
model_annotations.English: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean values of three different hidden state metrics across layers in a neural network architecture. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 25, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," also uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4. The plot contains three distinct lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at approximately 0.1, remains relatively low and stable until layer 15, then sharply increases to approximately 4.2 by layer 25; a yellow dotted line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains consistently near 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line with circular markers representing the "hidden state mean of baseline," which remains very low, hovering near 0.04 across all layers.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert der verborgenen Zustände entlang der Schichtentwicklung in einem neuronalen Netzwerk, wobei drei verschiedene Messgrößen verglichen werden: der Mittelwert vor dem Gate, der Mittelwert nach dem Gate und der Mittelwert einer Baseline. Die x-Achse stellt die Schichtnummer dar, skaliert linear von 0 bis etwa 25, mit Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 und Einheiten „Layer“. Die y-Achse zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert („Abs Mean“), skaliert linear von 0 bis über 4, mit Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 1. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie repräsentiert den „hidden state mean before gate“, beginnt bei etwa 0.0 und steigt bis zu einem Wert von etwa 4.5 bei Schicht 25; sie zeigt eine allgemeine steigende Tendenz mit mehreren Spitzen und Rückgängen, z. B. einen Wert von etwa 0.3 bei Schicht 5 und einen Wert von etwa 0.7 bei Schicht 10. Die gelb-durchgezogene Linie stellt den „hidden state mean after gate“ dar, beginnt bei etwa 0.0 und bleibt nahezu konstant bei einem Wert von etwa 0.05 bis Schicht 25. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie zeigt den „hidden state mean of baseline“, beginnt bei etwa 0.0 und bleibt nahezu konstant bei einem Wert von etwa 0.04 bis Schicht 25.
